description: Remove, disconnect or delete an MCP server from a Replo project by the address it was added at. Its tools stop working at once, for everyone it was connected for. Confirm with the user first. To connect it again, use add_mcp_server. Each integration has a skill named by its key: before using an integration's tools, read it (call skills with name "shopify", for example).

connectionScope.description: Which connection to remove: the project's, or only this person's own.

projectId.description: The project to remove it from.

serverUrl.description: The address the server was added at, as its integrations entry or Integrations shows it.

name: remove_mcp_server
title: Remove an MCP server
